description: I am pleased to share that the bill I introduced, (H.757, An Act Relating to Manufactured Homes and Limited-Equity Cooperatives) in the House General & Housing Committee was signed into law by the Governor on June 17, 2026.Like many pieces of legislation, it evolved considerably as it moved through the House and Senate.
